Team —

Quick reminder as we head into the deadline week for Q4 forecasting: the submission window opens Monday (Oct 5) and closes EOD Friday. I want to lock down a tight cadence this week so Finance can validate commit numbers before the executive checkpoint. Please do the following by Monday 10/5 10:00 AM PT: 

- Update HubSpot stage to either "Commit", "Commit — At Risk", or "Commit — Needs Approval" for any active deals.
- Ensure expected close date and forecasted ARR are populated on the deal record.
- Attach/update the latest proposal or SOW under Documents on the HubSpot deal.

I've attached a one-sheet forecast template and the sync agenda for Monday's call (30 minutes). Key agenda items: pipeline hygiene rollups, >$250k deal spot-checks, and blockers requiring finance/leadership review.

Call: Mon Oct 5, 11:00 AM PT — 11:30 AM PT (30 min) — join link in calendar.

Attachments: FY26_Q4_forecast_template.xlsx (fill only the "forecast" tab), sync_agenda_oct5.md

Please flag any deals you want me to push into the review queue in advance (comment on the HubSpot deal or reply all).

Thanks —
